notes.title: Planned Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! Just a quick announcement to let you know our plans for Raccoons to Riches' Steam Deck compatibility.

Good news, we're planning on it! As part of developing the game, we've been testing the game on Steam Deck, and it works really well! You should be able to play the game fully on Steam Deck at time of release. We're planning on getting the game to Verified status post-release.

Thanks for checking out the game on Steam Deck! See you in the shop soon![/p]
